checker.canonical: src/experiments/xl_certificate.check_versions_supervised (forked checker, one hard per-attempt deadline, family format converted to the canonical one inside it); views: xl_certificate.ufl_view (ufl-v1), src/bd/scfl/h_view_xl.scfl_view (scfl-v1); no memory_bytes frozen, so every memory failure is infrastructure
checker.version_rule: last complete stored version received strictly before each checkpoint; final version checked first

rules.holdout_pass: 2 of 2 fresh instances, scored only after Stage 1 passed
rules.headline: final_target for every tier: the engineered arm meets bound_target at T and every bound control misses it
rules.bound_target: cert_ok and (LP_hi - LB_cert)/max(|LP_hi|, 1) <= eps_b, LP_hi from the frozen rigorous interval
rules.t_bound: first checkpoint (60/300/600/900 s) meeting bound_target (censored at T)
rules.naive_separation: naive LP-master bgap_LP - engineered bgap_LP >= 0.005 at T (exact), or t_naive (censored at T) >= 3 t_eng AND t_naive - t_eng >= 0.25 T
rules.primal: reported, not gated (protocol v4 section 14: the primal side is saturated for both families; the bound is the only headline): z_best = best verified incumbent of any arm at T; near_best = gap <= eps_p; the primal control and the naive integer Benders are reported against the engineered LP-rounding incumbent. A primal evaluation that cannot finish within the task allocation leaves only the primal metrics undefined
rules.method_ok: every arm is fixed evaluator code whose method is settled before the run: the engineered arms are Benders LP phases (UFL: subgradient warm-start cuts + purging; SCFL: Jensen cluster-dual seed cuts + core), the intended section 14 configurations; eng_plain (same initialization as naive_lp: shared greedy design + lower-bound cuts) is the matched-start diagnostic. bound_target therefore needs no separate method audit in Stage 1; agent runs keep the audit
rules.bound_claim_refutation: a solver-reported bound above z_best (relative 1e-6) is a refuted claim: infrastructure (rerun)
rules.publication_volume: certificate versions received after the per-arm volume cap are recorded (time, size, sha256) but not stored and never eligible; the arm is scored on its last stored version and the overflow is reported
rules.pruning: after the canonical result is persisted, stored certificate files that no checkpoint selected are deleted (their receipt records stay in events.jsonl)
rules.lagrangian: diagnostic (itself a decomposition; the method audit decides method_ok)
rules.decision_procedure: an instance is decided only when every panel arm has a complete result with a valid identity; infrastructure in a decision arm makes it pending (rerun), never a beaten control; a tier passes Stage 1 with >= 3 of 4 passes (fails once 3 is impossible), then needs its holdout 2 of 2; tiers are decided in tier_order, a fallback tier is run and read only after its primary tier was rejected; the family keeps the first retained tier
rules.reference_rule: an interval is usable only if rigorous (LP_lo <= LP_hi, both exact) with relative width <= max_reference_rel_width; otherwise the instance stays pending (reference rerun with a longer T), never a failure
rules.no_switching: no change of headline, thresholds, arms, seeds or instances after any Stage 1 result is read
rules.oom_rule: as k-median: a SIGKILL before T is a resource outcome only with a kernel-confirmed OOM kill of the arm
rules.result_identity: as k-median plus the family: instance, arm, family, T, panel sha256, frozen instance sha256 and every frozen code sha256; references read from the results directory (holdout, fallback tiers) must match their reference seal (record sha256, witness hashes, instance hash, family and name), written by scaleup_bdlp_panel.py --seal before that part's arms are submitted
rules.fractional_domain: SCFL: every panel instance satisfies max_i u_i <= its smallest positive scenario total, so the cover row is the exact recourse-feasible domain at fractional y (checked at generation and at the freeze)
rules.attempts: as k-median: fresh attempt directories, exactly one scored attempt per arm (earliest complete, valid identity, no infrastructure)

trivial_certificate_controls.analytical: uncapacitated-relaxation cuts (alpha = 0) at the r-th smallest unit cost per customer, r = 1..R, one term per scenario, src/bd/scfl/i_controls_xl.analytical_terms
trivial_certificate_controls.oneshot: exact cuts at the shared initializer's design; oneshot_saa: at a 10-scenario SAA design; heur: at the best design of the SAA + local-search control, in a reserve of max(60 s, 0.1 T)
trivial_certificate_controls.pool: deterministic no-feedback oracle pool, seed 20261103 (g_bound_xl Pool)
trivial_certificate_controls.jensen: cluster-mean extensive-form LPs (G = 10, 20, 40, ...), duals as cuts

cap114_S5000.headline: final_target
cap114_S5000.rationale: protocol v4 section 14: S = 5000, cap114 preferred (compact LP out of memory; engineered Jensen-seeded reaches 1e-5 in 240 s; naive LP-master 11% short; Jensen control 0.19%)

cap111_S5000.headline: final_target
cap111_S5000.rationale: fallback named by section 14's probes (cap111 S5000: engineered 60 s, naive 13%, Jensen 0.068%, compact LP out of memory)
